scope: Published local observations of named currents associated with approximate OSW states by named geography, reported cross-stream section bands, or reported instrument points.
claim_limit: Local studies, cross-stream sections and instrument points do not establish a whole-current path, along-flow length or permanent state passage. Reported instrument coordinates and section bounds are not current axes or whole-current footprints. Month precision is preserved where exact days are absent.

entries.name: Northern Current
entries.time_detail: Glider measurements ran 2–19 December 2011; HF radar fields ran 6–19 December 2011. This row records the combined study window, not continuous coverage by both instruments.
entries.spatial_basis: The source locates the study off Toulon in the northwestern Mediterranean and describes the repeated glider transects at 6.20°E. It does not provide a reusable digitized current footprint in this ledger.
entries.state_boundary_limit: The approximate OSW NECS polygon overlaps parts of the mapped Mediterranean coastal strip. The MEDI assignment follows the source's named sea, not a sampled footprint/polygon intersection.

entries.name: Canary Current
entries.time_detail: The dates bound the entire ORCA cruise; the exact occupation dates of this current band are not separately assigned here.
entries.spatial_basis: The paper reports the Canary Current extent along the 29°N section from 22.25°W to 18.5°W. This is a cross-stream band, not an along-current trace.
entries.state_boundary_limit: The reported cross-stream band intersects the approximate NAST E polygon; the state boundary and observed current extent are not surveyed together.

entries.name: Alaska Coastal Current (Gulf of Alaska)
entries.reported_locality: Shelikof Sea Valley, Gulf of Alaska; not the exit-to-Shelikof-Strait mooring line
entries.time_detail: Published Table 1 caption explicitly identifies 10 May-15 July 1989 as a sea-valley transport interval. The dates delimit this local calculation, not the full 1984-2014 study window or continuous coverage of the entire coastal system.
entries.source_locator: Published article, PDF page 4 (printed page 26), Table 1 caption, 10 May-15 July 1989 sea-valley exception; PDF page 5 (printed page 27), section 2.2, mooring-array location in 1989; section 3.3 describes the coastal-current transport context. Published PDF: https://workspace.aoos.org/files/2656915/Stabeno_etal_2016_Longterm_Obs_ACC.pdf
entries.spatial_basis: The paper identifies mooring arrays in Shelikof Sea Valley for the 1989 transport calculation. This is published local coastal-current evidence; no array endpoints, station coordinates, observed current axis, or footprint are digitized here.
entries.state_boundary_limit: ALSK is assigned by the source-reported northern Gulf of Alaska locality. This is a semantic regional association, not an observed-geometry intersection with the approximate OSW polygon; no BERS association follows from this observation.

entries.name: Kuroshio Current
entries.reported_locality: Three moorings east of Luzon at 18 degrees north, 122.7, 123.0 and 123.3 degrees east
entries.time_detail: The paper reports January 2018 to May 2020, without exact deployment and recovery days here. This is the reported study window, not a claim of continuous valid coverage at every depth or station.
entries.source_locator: Abstract; section 2 Data and method; section 3.1 Mean structure; Figures 1-3
entries.spatial_basis: OSW projects the three paper-reported instrument positions into the approximate coast-masked state polygons. All three positions fall in CHIN. These are mooring locations, not the Kuroshio axis or an interpolated cross-stream boundary.
entries.observation_depth_note: The source reports combined profiles spanning roughly 900 m, with the upper 50 m excluded; the downward ADCP at 123 degrees east malfunctioned. Deeper Luzon Undercurrent flow is distinct from the upper Kuroshio.
entries.state_boundary_limit: The CHIN link is a lookup of three instrument points against approximate display geography; it is not whole-current containment, intersection, or a measured state boundary. The paper places the current core west of the array.
